# MoodleGPT 3

> Instant AI answers on any Moodle quiz — verified database, Gemini AI & full automation.

MoodleGPT 3 is a browser extension for Google Chrome and Chromium-based browsers designed to assist students and educators using the Moodle Learning Management System (LMS). It accelerates and automates quiz solving using a multi-tiered architecture: an instant verified question-and-answer cache, Google Gemini AI (Gemini 2.5 Flash, 2.5 Pro, and 3 Pro Preview), and automated keyboard workflows.

## Key Features

- **Instant AI Answering**: Automatically analyzes question text, formulas, code, and images to generate verified, accurate solutions.
- **Verified Q&A Database**: Built-in cache of thousands of verified quiz solutions for instantaneous, zero-latency answers.
- **Multimodal Image Support**: Extracts and analyzes embedded question figures, diagrams, formulas, and screenshots using Gemini Vision models.
- **Stealth UI & Overlay System**: Clean, unobtrusive interface with customizable opacity, dark mode, keyboard shortcuts (Alt+Q, Alt+A, Alt+C), and discreet overlay rendering.
- **Full Automation Mode**: Automatically solves, reviews, selects answers, and navigates sequential quiz questions with configurable timing and delays.
- **Broad Question Type Support**: Handles multiple choice, true/false, fill-in-the-blanks, dropdown selections, short answers, matching questions, numerical questions, and multi-select checkboxes.
- **Multilingual Support**: Supports solving quizzes in any language worldwide, with the extension interface localized in 5 languages (English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, German).
- **Privacy-First**: No personal data collection, no telemetry tracking, and direct client-to-Google Gemini API architecture.
